text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun achieved glorious results 
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome those truly precious 
"first three years" together, today she is 
full of energy once again—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya-chin, taaaakeoooooff!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man! Why did Brian-san take 1st place 
again?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, you're the one slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's mean, so mean~! Then let's 
run one more time~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way~☆ Mayano is running with me 
next time★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hawa! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi, alright then, Mave-chin! Race ya☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Bring it on—☆★

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...She really is just a kid.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? And who's the one getting all worked 
up over a kid?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're just like me, aren't you? I saw you 
challenging her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You betcha! Even one-on-one against 
Mayano, I'm gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Honestly, sarcasm is totally lost 
on them...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Phew...☆ With that, today's matched 
training is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You've still got me and Nature left!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'll pass. You youngsters should 
just do it among yourselves..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but... I know you're itching 
to get out there!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Guess we've got no choice but to do 
it☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hah!? Wh-Whoa, hold on, you guys――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. Hey, you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Isn't that one free yet?
choice_data_list: It's because Mayano is so popular.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Why do you look so happy? That guy was 
the one who asked for a rematch, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Pass on a message for me. I'm tired 
today. 'Make sure I'm the first one you 
run alongside tomorrow.'

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph............ ...I have high hopes for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat!? Trainer-chan, are you cheating 
on me!?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Jeez, I'm done running! Today is 
officially just a date!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't give me that "Huh?"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I finished all my training matches and 
schedule properly for today anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what's the harm? ...Even if you 
get all romantic with Maya once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!! I looooove you, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, meet in front of the school 
gate in 10 minutes! You copy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And I ended up going along with Mayano Top 
Gun on her date—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Made it just in the nick of time!
choice_data_list:
I never thought I'd be roped in until 
nightfall...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~☆ It's fine once in a while! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's gotten a little more mature too, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I kinda wanted Trainer-chan to say 
"a whole bunch," you know~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but I guess it can't be helped. 
It's fine. After all, Maya still—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Because it feels like I can become an 
even more glamorous, mature woman!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The place where Maya can truly sparkle... 
was right here all along, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Running with all my might alongside 
everyone, even if sometimes I don't win.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is having the most fun right now! 
It's so exciting, and my heart is racing!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it really feels like it's 
sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so listen up, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Please keep making me shine, now and 
forever!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know... there's still sooo much that 
Maya wants to do!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna go on a date to the beach with 
Trainer-chan, and I wanna check out an 
amusement park at night too!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there are so many races I haven't 
run yet that I want to try!
choice_data_list: You can do it all, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fufu, Maya thinks so too☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Because you're right by Maya's side!
